title: The gourd that must be lifted
odia:
ନିଲଜ ଲାଉ
ଟେକି ଟାକି ଦେଲେ ପିଢାକୁ ଯାଉ।
literal_meaning: Shameless gourd! When lifted up, you go onto the pidha.
meaning_odia: ଲାଉକୁ ନିଲଜ ବୋଲି ସମ୍ବୋଧନ କରି କଥକ କହୁଛନ୍ତି, ଟେକି ଦେଲେ ସେ ପିଢ଼ାକୁ ଯାଏ। ଆମ ସମ୍ପାଦକୀୟ ପାଠରେ ଏହା ଅନ୍ୟର ସାହାଯ୍ୟରେ ଉପରକୁ ଉଠିବା ଉପରେ ଏକ କଟାକ୍ଷ। ଏଠାରେ ପିଢ଼ାକୁ ସମ୍ପାଦକୀୟ ପାଠରେ ଲାଉ ମାଡ଼ିବାର ଚାଳ ବା ଆଧାର ଭାବେ ବୁଝାଯାଇଛି; ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ଗଠନ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ନୁହେଁ। ସାହାଯ୍ୟ ଦରକାର ହେବାକୁ ନିଜେ ଲଜ୍ଜାର ବିଷୟ ବୋଲି ଧରାଯାଇନାହିଁ।
explanation: The gourd is addressed like a person and mocked for reaching its support through someone else’s lifting. Our editorial reading focuses on dependence on that help. The force of the taunt belongs to the speaker; the image alone does not make assistance a moral failing.
usage_example: Original imagined example: A teammate waits for others to initiate every step before joining in. An impatient colleague recalls the gourd that moves upward when lifted, making their frustration audible.
cultural_context: The verse turns an ordinary lifting action into an exchange with a gourd. Pidha is retained in translation and read here as a roof or growing support; its precise structure remains uncertain.

odia_summary: ଅନ୍ୟେ ଟେକି ଦେଲେ ପିଢ଼ାକୁ ଯାଉଥିବା ଲାଉ ପ୍ରତି କଥକଙ୍କ କଟାକ୍ଷ।
english_summary: A gourd is teased for going upward when someone lifts it.
